text: …　くらくて　よく　みえないんだもん

structure.jp: よく　みえないんだもん
structure.en: I can't see well, that's why

patterns.name: 〜のだもの
patterns.explanation: んだもん is the casual, slightly childish form of のだもの, used to give an excuse: 'because, you see'. みえないんだもん = 'because I can't see'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this part to the next and here gives the reason. くらくて　よく　みえない = 'it's dark, so I can't see well'.
